messages:
ana: Filed a small docs PR to reconcile Dedicated provisioning examples and add a short note on cooldown tradeoffs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4802
docs-bot: [linkcheck] scanning PR #4802 for broken links
mike: nice. one consistency nit: use min_replicas/max_replicas everywhere. saw a snippet with min/max.
jess: also add one sentence under Isolation that calls out tenant-labels and noisy-tenant churn when cooldowns are short. helps customers tune.
infra-bot: recommended SLA link: https://console.redwood.ai/sla (internal).
ana: thanks — updated the Python snippet to use DedicatedClient.create_capacity and swapped keys to min_replicas/max_replicas. added brief KV cache warmup note.
mike: lgtm after tiny docs formatting fix (code fence language). CI?
docs-bot: [CI] lint + linkcheck passed for PR #4802
ana: merging after CI. release note: "docs: standardize provisioning keys, clarify cooldown isolation impacts, add examples". ping #eng-oncall if rollback needed.
